en.name: Dry salad dressing mix
en.summary: This is the paper sachet of seasoning you shake up with oil, vinegar and sometimes buttermilk or mayonnaise. There is no published cupboard timeline for the dry packet itself. Once it has been made up, refrigerate the dressing and use it within about 4 weeks. Freezing is not recommended.
en.pantry: The unopened sachet lives in a cool, dry cupboard, but no keeping time is published for it, so the printed date on the packet is the guide. Dry is the whole requirement: the powder draws moisture out of humid air and cakes, and a caked sachet will not disperse smoothly into a dressing. Keep packets away from the hob and the kettle, and if you open one and use only part of it, tip the rest into a small airtight jar rather than folding the paper over.
en.fridge: The published figure belongs to the made-up dressing: about 4 weeks at 4 °C (40 °F) or below in a sealed jar or shaker bottle. If your version includes buttermilk, yoghurt or mayonnaise, treat it as the perishable end of that and do not stretch it. Shake before each use, since a packet dressing separates faster than a bottled one, and keep it on an inside shelf rather than in the door.
en.freezer: Freezing is not recommended and no freezer timeline is given. A made-up dressing is an oil-and-vinegar or dairy emulsion, and both split on thawing into oil with sediment or curds beneath. The dry powder gains nothing from the freezer either and risks picking up condensation every time the packet comes out. Mix the quantity you will get through.
spoilage: A caked, solid sachet that will not break up
A stale or rancid smell from the packet
Made-up dressing that has separated and will not shake back together
Mould, a sour smell or fizzing in the mixed dressing
tips: Decant part-used sachets into a small airtight jar with the date.
Keep packets away from steam — damp is what ends a dry mix.
Label the shaker bottle with the date you mixed it.
Make up half a packet at a time if a whole batch outlasts your salads.

faq.q: How long does made-up dressing from a packet last?
faq.a: About 4 weeks refrigerated at 4 °C or below in a sealed bottle. Dairy-based versions are at the short end.

faq.q: How long does a dry dressing sachet keep?
faq.a: No keeping time is published for the packet itself. Follow the printed date and store it airtight in a cool dry cupboard.

faq.q: Can you freeze made-up salad dressing?
faq.a: Freezing is not recommended and no timeline is given. The emulsion splits on thawing.

faq.q: Why won't my dressing mix dissolve?
faq.a: The powder has absorbed moisture and caked. Store sachets airtight and away from steam.

zh.name: 乾式沙拉醬粉包
zh.summary: 這裡指的是那種要自己加油、醋，有時再加白脫牛奶或美乃滋搖勻的調味粉包。乾粉包本身沒有已發表的櫥櫃保存期限。調好之後請冷藏，並在大約 4 週內用完。不建議冷凍。
zh.pantry: 未開封的粉包放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，但官方沒有為它公布保存天數，所以請以包裝上的日期為準。唯一的要求就是乾燥：粉會從潮濕空氣中吸水結塊，結塊的粉包也調不出滑順的沙拉醬。請遠離爐火和熱水壺；若一包只用了一部分，請把剩下的倒進小密封罐，不要只把袋口折起來。
zh.fridge: 已發表的數字講的是調好的成品：放在密封玻璃罐或搖搖瓶裡，4 °C 以下大約 4 週。如果你的版本加了白脫牛奶、優格或美乃滋，請算在較短的那一端，不要硬撐。每次使用前先搖勻，因為粉包調成的醬比瓶裝醬更容易分層；並且放在冰箱內側層架而不是門邊。
zh.freezer: 不建議冷凍，也沒有提供冷凍期限。調好的沙拉醬是油醋或乳製品的乳化液，兩者解凍後都會分離，上層是油、下層是沉澱或凝結物。乾粉放冷凍也沒有好處，每次拿出來還可能讓包裝內結冷凝水。請調你用得完的量。
spoilage: 粉包結成敲不散的硬塊
包裝裡傳出陳味或油耗味
調好的醬已經分層、搖不回去
調好的醬長霉、發酸或冒泡
tips: 用剩的粉包倒進小密封罐，並標上日期。
遠離蒸氣——毀掉乾粉的是潮濕。
在搖搖瓶上寫調製日期。
如果一整包調出來吃不完，就一次調半包。

faq.q: 粉包調好的沙拉醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 密封放 4 °C 以下冷藏大約 4 週。含乳製品的版本屬於較短的那一端。

faq.q: 乾的沙拉醬粉包可以放多久？
faq.a: 粉包本身沒有已發表的保存天數。請依包裝日期，並密封放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃。

faq.q: 調好的沙拉醬可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 不建議，也沒有提供期限。解凍後乳化會分離。

faq.q: 沙拉醬粉為什麼調不開？
faq.a: 它吸了濕氣結塊了。請密封存放並遠離蒸氣。
